status_note: EXT2025 comparisons with Ultimate Tennis Statistics' fixed formula (and, when its pass exists, Ingram's Bayesian point model) on ATP 2024, 2025 and pooled 2024-2025 (design amendments A2, A2 correction and A4). 2025 was inspected before the model freeze (D134) and scored by REFIT2025 (D137 ATP, D138 WTA): it is exposed retrospective data, not a holdout. The accepted 2024 results (EXTERNAL_2024_2025_RESULTS.json for UTS, ingram_2024.json for Ingram) remain the registered claims.

comparator.primary: the frozen model (D134, ATP full_tier_entry): the saved forecast carried by G-L run (b); the README row
comparator.continuity: the previous version (ATP full_tier), the comparator of the accepted 2024 rows: the saved forecast carried by G-L run (a)
comparator.note: G-L calibrates only its five baselines; the incumbent is the saved forecast unchanged (A2 correction)

metric_conventions.log_loss: mean natural log loss; lower is better
metric_conventions.brier: mean squared probability error; lower is better
metric_conventions.accuracy: threshold above 0.5, with half credit at exactly 0.5; higher is better
metric_conventions.incumbent_minus_external_log_loss: Alcaraz minus the external system, paired on identical matches; negative favours Alcaraz
metric_conventions.uncertainty: stationary calendar-week block bootstrap on each block's own Monday grid; primary mean block 8 weeks, 4 and 13 as sensitivities

uts.label: Ultimate Tennis Statistics fixed-formula adaptation (public-data adaptation, not the website's own output)
uts.continuity_2024_equals_accepted: the continuity 2024 block equals the accepted UTS 2024 comparison value for value (checked by the builder)

ingram.label: Ingram's Bayesian point model (paper settings, 2024 seeds)
ingram.status: pending: the 2025 fit (runs-3) and its scoring pass with the same scorer (A4); until then the accepted Ingram 2024 row (ingram_2024.json) stands alone

limitations: public-data formula adaptation, not historical UTS website output or private-database equivalence
2025 was inspected before the model freeze (D134) and scored by REFIT2025 (D137 ATP, D138 WTA): it is exposed retrospective data, not a holdout.
UTS 2017-2023 is not run: 2017-2019 lie in the formula's weight-tuning window, 2020 to January 2021 predate its code, and 2021 would need a new timing exclusion (A2)
no claim of prospective validity, betting value or universal state of the art
